steps.content: When Ignis is brought into the interrogation room, she is clearly not in a good mood—which is normal. Anyone suddenly called into the small black chamber has good reason to be angry.
Her gaze lingers a moment on your hand. She has very keen powers of observation—what you're holding there is the detailed report on the arson case.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What do you want? A recitation of the glorious deeds of a Sinner?
I guess there's probably some misunderstanding here. I just want to have a chat with you.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Heh... Chat?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Like, "You have the right to remain silent. Anything you say shall be presented in a court of law." That kind of chat?
I just got here, I haven't learned how to do what you're talking about.
I just think there are still secrets surrounding that arson case.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: There aren't any secrets.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Why would I keep any secrets about that?
I have met many Sinners in a short period of time.
They hurt people because they lose control of their own abilities, and in many cases it is unintentional. I believe this arson was also unintentional.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You're overthinking it. I did it on purpose.
So why did you start the fire?
Ignis looks sideways at you and tilts her head, apparently out of patience.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I didn't have a reason. I'm a Sinner, and I like playing with fire.
So why did you turn yourself in? Shouldn't an arsonist like you hide from the police?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Turned myself in... Where did you hear that?

FAC records. Are they wrong?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: This is all nonsense.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: "I just want to have a chat with you." Wow, how nice of you to say it. But I know very well that you just want to coax information out of me.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You're no different from them!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You mean, deceptive hypocrites!
Maybe your words has finally provoked Ignis. Her attitude changes drastically, and she starts to attack you with words incessantly. This reminds you of a hedgehog with quills all up.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: A document without rhyme or reason.What can it prove?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I'm a violent, heartless sociopath, a evil, wicked villain, I'm just an irredeemable Sinner!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: So stop wasting your time. You're not getting anything you want from me.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I say that's it for today.
But rather than a weapon for an attack, her quills are more like something for self-defense.
Noticing the wariness in her eyes and her folded arms, you take back the evidence you just handed to Ignis, and decide to try another approach.
Those were just routine questions.
You whisper and lean toward her, trying your best to soften your attitude.
<size=25>Actually... I was hoping you could help me out.</size>

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What are you doing! Stand back!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Now I'm warning you, do not play tricks on me!
Ah... okay. It's just that I'm new here, and I don't know anything about food, so I was hoping I could ask Eastside's most famous girl food critic to help me.
I've been planning to ask some close colleagues out to eat. But... I'm new, and I'm not sure what food Eastside is famous for.
So... I wanted to ask Eastside's most famous girl food critic for her recommendation.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What... are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: Good morning, foodies, and welcome back! Today, I'm taking you along to try a ramen shop that I know you've never been to.

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: It's totally hard to find, tucked away in the abandoned 706 Factory building, but believe me, if you eat there even once, then you'll happily walk miles out of your way to get there, just like me...
You study Ignis's reaction. She is trying hard to act calm, but her heaving chest and darting eyes betray her.

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: Today I want to recommend a special winter-only ice cream, great for when the weather turns cold. The outside looks very chic. It's modeled after a nuclear power plant emitter, but don't worry, that's just a really thin layer...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Enough!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Stop... Stop playing that!
Ignis's face is red, and her voice is trembling. It looks like the account really is hers.
You are about to ask her, when suddenly you hear a pop.
Blue smoke is pouring out of the terminal, which has spontaneously combusted.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Ah, oops.
Water comes pouring down from the emergency sprinklers on the ceiling.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I... I didn't mean to...
You hurry to the controls to stop the water, and pull out a towel from a locker off to one side, to dry off Ignis's soaked hair and face.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You can't keep playing it! Or else I... Or else I...
She looks like she wants to kill you, but her eyes are full of tears, which makes the threat sound more like a desperate plea.
You have confirmed one thing Ignis loses control of her ability when her emotions are high, but she feels ill at ease and guilty about it.
Okay, I'll stop.
But... you write quite well.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: <size=25>What does it matter that I write well...</size>

options: Everyone says you're hard to get along with.
I see a different side of you.

choices.text: Everyone says you're hard to get along with.
I see a different side of you.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Sinners like me... are just like that.
But the Ignis I see here is lively and cheerful, helpful, popular with everyone.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: That's all fake.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The blog was the only place I could interact with other people like a normal person.
Like a normal person? You found out early on that you were a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: So what if I did? You guys were right. I'm just a piece of trash, I can't even control my own ability.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Sinner, murderer, arsonist, aren't people like us all like that? Can't even control their own abilities, always hurting other people.
No, I would never—

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Hmph.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I don't believe you.
She can't hide her emotions at all. Even though she's bickering with you, her eyes are clearly saying, "Really?"
So... you're always trying hard to control your own emotions?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: No, I have a device to help me. It warns me if I pass a critical threshold.
Your parents didn't help you?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: ...They helped, but not with this. They just didn't want me to be discovered.
And what would happen if you were discovered?
She opens her mouth, then closes it without answering.

As soon as you ask, you guess the answer. There were comments left from some crazy fans the night before the food festival, before Ignis's blog was shut down, saying that they had found out the blogger's real identity.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: That day at home, I posted a blog entry located at the food festival. After work at the restaurant that morning, I was getting ready to take a shower, and they barged in...
They scared you, made you lose control of your ability and start the fire. But that wasn't what you wanted, right?
You're right, Ignis hasn't denied it. Her eyes have gone red, and she lowers her head.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: It was all my fault, I was too greedy.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I knew that would happen... I shouldn't have written that damn blog.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: My life was good enough. I should have known not to do anything that would cause trouble.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I did it, I'm responsible for everything. There's nothing more to say.
What is she really scared of? Is she afraid of people? That can't be it.
She shut herself up at home and didn't interact with other people, not because she was scared of them, but because she was scared of hurting them.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: So whose fault is it?
Some things aren't anyone's fault. It's hard to say... Those people who scared you are more to blame than you. You're a victim.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What's the use? What's done is done.
You have already done a lot to make up for that.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: No, I can never make up for that. I should have turned myself in sooner.
Turned herself in sooner? You start to chew over that sentence.
If her ability had been out of control since she was six, how did she hide until she was sixteen? In a place like Eastside, even a whisper of a Sinner would have caused a panic.
You think about what she said so lightly earlier.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: They helped... But not with this.
You pull out the earlier material and begin reading.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What are you saying?
Two people went missing that day, did you know that?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: ...What does that have to do with me.
The words stick in your throat—you don't know if you should say this.
But in order to understand Ignis's reasons for turning herself in, you have to ask.

options: Were those two people your parents?

choices.text: Were those two people your parents?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I've no idea what you're talking about!
She tenses, and her face grows serious, showing a fear you havn't seen before.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I don't... I don't know, I don't know!
The temperature in the interrogation room starts to shoot up. One of Ignis's mood swings is starting. Maybe you shouldn't have said this.
But...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Enough!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: This has nothing to do with my parents! They're good people. This was all my fault!
She stares at you angrily.
You hear a quiet beeping coming from the walls of the interrogation room. The broken-down old circuits can't take high heat, and would go up like fireworks.
All you can do is call Nightingale, and have her take Ignis back to rest.
But your suspicions linger...
